FX-BLEND-ADDF-001.says: Float. The card, and above it in Add the card two stops up (four times): white plus four times white is five, not held to 1.

FX-BLEND-ADDF-002.says: The same file in Display (no `float_depth`): Add held to 1, as before D-319.

FX-BLEND-ADDF-003.says: Float. The card in Add on the card, nothing brightened: white plus white is 2.

FX-BLEND-SCRF-001.says: Float. Both cards two stops up, the top in Screen: where both are past white the brighter is kept, Nuke's rule.

FX-BLEND-SCRF-002.says: Float. The top card two stops up in Screen on the plain card: one of the two is at most 1 everywhere, so `cs + cd - cs cd` throughout.

FX-BLEND-SCRF-003.says: FX-BLEND-SCRF-001 in Display: `cs + cd - cs cd` as before D-319, which turns down past white.

FX-FNOISE-HDR-001.says: Float. Fractal Noise, size 4, contrast 300, brightness 50, on the card: the brightest clouds go past white, the darkest still stop at black.

FX-FNOISE-HDR-002.says: FX-FNOISE-HDR-001 in Display: held to 0..1, as before D-319.

FX-FNOISE-HDR-003.says: Float. The card two stops up, then FX-FNOISE-HDR-001's noise in Screen: where both are past white the brighter is kept.
